verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents an Exports API. It supports multiple export types (customers, screenings, screening and monitoring cases, profiles, payment screening cases, transaction monitoring cases and alerts, transactions) selected by date range, and transaction data can be exported as CSV for use outside the platform. However, it does not show that everything is exportable, that every export uses an open format, or how to leave the service. missing for 10: confirmation that all data types (configurations, risk-score equations, audit trails, roles) are covered by bulk export, documented open formats for every export type beyond transaction CSV, account deletion/offboarding documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
